Rapid Postmortem Temporal Bone Extraction and Dissection of Human Inner Ear Organs From Organ Donors.

中文摘要

我们开发了一种用于器官捐献者死后颞骨提取和解剖的方案，能够在缺血后1-2小时内实现无创双侧颞骨获取，随后对神经感觉器官进行逐步显微外科解剖。结合快速提取、简化脱钙和无创显微外科解剖，该方案为人内耳组织获取建立了一个科学上多用途的框架。

英文摘要

We developed a postmortem protocol for temporal bone extraction and dissection in organ donors, enabling atraumatic bilateral temporal bone retrieval within 1-2 h of ischemia, followed by stepwise microsurgical dissection of neurosensory organs. Combining rapid extraction, abbreviated decalcification, and atraumatic microsurgical dissection, this protocol establishes a scientifically versatile framework for human inner ear tissue acquisition.
